method: Primary publisher pages inspected through web search/open. Scope is the exact planning passages described below, not whole-guide fact checking.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Bhubaneswar
sources.inspection: Identifies the old town as Ekamra Kshetra and describes Hindu, Buddhist and Jain heritage. No single opening schedule for the whole city.

guides.remaining: Site-by-site entry eligibility, access, toilets, transport and opening arrangements need local verification.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Dhauligiri
sources.inspection: Dates the Peace Pagoda to 1972. The page mentions a light-and-sound show but does not verify a performance for a chosen travel date.

guides.remaining: Current show operation, tickets, approach, steps, toilets and accessible routes remain unverified.

sources.title: Archaeological Survey of India · Sun Temple, Konarak
sources.inspection: Lists opening from sunrise to sunset. Fees and entry conditions must be checked again before travel; no fixed clock times copied.

guides.remaining: Ticket purchase not exercised; current museum opening, festival schedule, route access and facilities remain unverified.

sources.title: Incredible India · Puri
sources.inspection: October–February seasonal suggestion and the named coastal dishes inspected. The page’s transport widget is not used as route evidence.

guides.remaining: Temple entry rules, facilities, crowd conditions and shore conditions need current official/local confirmation.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Raghurajpur
sources.inspection: Describes the craft village approximately 12 km from Puri. Its general free-entry listing is not treated as a free workshop or demonstration promise.

guides.remaining: Named maker, appointment, demonstration fee, facilities and accessible approach remain unverified.

sources.title: Incredible India · Puri
sources.inspection: October–February seasonal suggestion and the named coastal dishes inspected. The page’s transport widget is not used as route evidence.

guides.remaining: No restaurant, live menu, dietary suitability, preparation conditions or Mahaprasad arrangements verified.

sources.title: Incredible India · Ramachandi setting
sources.inspection: Ramachandi passage places the shore at the Kushabhadra river and Bay of Bengal. No property inspection or swimming-safety claim inferred.

guides.remaining: No named property, room, transport availability, access, noise level or booking terms inspected.

rejected_inferences: Do not infer free artist demonstrations from Raghurajpur village entry guidance.
Do not copy the Puri page’s nearest-station widget into travel instructions; its Balugaon listing requires separate investigation.
Do not turn a mention of a Dhauli show into a current performance promise.
Do not copy old festival dates into 2026 schedules.
A commercial/private temple guide is not sufficient by itself to establish current temple entry authority.
source_access_limit: The attempted Lingaraj temple URL was not accessible; no new eligibility rule was added from it.
